responsibility: Serves as the high-level LLVM support facade for `rustc_codegen_llvm`, re-exporting raw bindings and providing safe or ergonomic wrappers for common LLVM operations such as attribute construction, linkage and visibility control, globals and comdats, naming, module flags, string/error extraction, and owned operand-bundle management.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `llvm/ffi.rs`, this `mod.rs` sits above the raw bindings and provides the ergonomic support facade used by the rest of the backend: re-exports plus safe wrappers for attributes, globals, linkage, names, module flags, and owned operand bundles. Unlike `coverageinfo/mod.rs` or `debuginfo/mod.rs`, it is infrastructure shared across LLVM codegen rather than a feature-specific state manager.
